title: Grass track: OSM maps grass over the track

options: grass track between the two pins
not grass: another surface on the track
not our track: another level (a bridge, an underpass)
findings.info: Hládkov - Brusnice: OSM maps grass over the track for 540 m (s 835-1375), and nothing we know says so. Is the track grassed here? The pins are where OSM's grass starts and ends; grass track stops at platforms, crossings and junctions by itself.
